007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExportTeamParams;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExportTeamRequest;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
015
016/** Sample for exporting a DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT team definition. */
017public final class ExportTeamSample {
018
019    private ExportTeamSample() {
020    }
021
022    /**
023     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
024     *
025     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
026     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
027     */
028    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
029        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
030        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
031            Team team = selectAIAgent.team(teamName);
032            String location = env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXPORT_LOCATION");
033            if (location == null) {
034                ExportTeamParams params = ExportTeamParams.builder()
035                        .overwrite(optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXPORT_OVERWRITE"))
036                        .build();
037                System.out.println(team.exportDefinition(params));
038                return;
039            }
040            ExportTeamRequest request = ExportTeamRequest.builder(location)
041                    .objectStorageCredentialName(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_OBJECT_STORAGE_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
042                    .overwrite(optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXPORT_OVERWRITE"))
043                    .build();
044            boolean exported = team.exportDefinition(request);
045            System.out.printf("Export team '%s' completed: %s%n", teamName, exported);
046        }
047    }
048
049    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
050        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
051                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
052                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
053                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
054                .build());
055    }
056
057    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
058        String value = System.getenv(name);
059        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
060            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
061        }
062        return value;
063    }
064
065    private static String env(String name) {
066        String value = System.getenv(name);
067        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
068    }
069
070    private static Boolean optionalBoolean(String name) {
071        String value = env(name);
072        return value == null ? null : Boolean.valueOf(value);
073    }
074}
